answer: Each fake identity must moor one haven on a distinct ripple of the dawn tide, paying the k-th prime number of tide-stones: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11. N fakes cost 129 for 10 and 24,133 for 100, since prime gaps widen as k grows. Two havens moored on the same ripple collide and both wash away at the close, so clones cannot share one ripple to split the toll.
